purpose: Locate the effect of input quantization before considering changes to the FlyVis core.
execution_block: AGENTS.md section9.1: weekday computations stop07:40 Europe/Moscow until author returns or explicitly authorizes another window.
known_from_source: runs/full_template_native_20261109/sparse_views.py: SparseFrames applies lamina processing to the full grayscale frame before cropping.
SparseViews.render resizes the processed crop to391x391, performs13x13 averaging, samples721 cells, then casts the result tofloat16.
runs/full_template_native_20261109/native_runtime.py: the saved retinal values feed both C34 and R1; promoting them tofloat32 does not restore discarded bits.
scripts/z13_target_model.py: R1 contains17 EMA channels and17 input-minus-EMA channels. Before storage/normalization rounding, each corresponding pair sums to the current retinal input.
research_fixed_crop_probe_20261112/render.py quantizes both native and independent rendered arrays tofloat16. Its exact reproduction check does not measure the effect of avoiding input quantization.
hypothesis_not_evidence: Rounding may affect low-contrast distinctions, but its causal contribution to the observed identity errors is not measured. It must not be presented as a found cause.

registration_required_before_execution.cases: All five cases232,70,1102,574,832 and both endpoints, using complete original observation schedules.
registration_required_before_execution.variant: Preserve the native float32 retinal sample before its finalfloat16 cast. Change no other operation. Reconstruct float16 only for the exact baseline witness.

stage1_cpu_inputs.method: Restore only required frames using validated sequential decoder/checkpoints. Retain nativefloat32 eye outputs before casting, alongside theirfloat16 copies. Independently verify averaging before the cast. Compare full arrays and sampled patch moments, not only final scores.
stage1_cpu_inputs.mandatory_baseline: Every newly rendered float32 view cast tofloat16 must equal the original saved view exactly; otherwise stop and diagnose restoration. No tolerance relaxation.
outputs: before/after input hashes and immutable archive check
stage1_cpu_inputs.limits: Current retinal input is an image representation, not an object-ID label; raw-intensity similarity alone cannot establish true correspondence.

stage2_frozen_module.permission: Only within a newly authorized computation window; one guarded model process, resource limits and deadline recorded before launch.
stage2_frozen_module.mandatory_baseline: Reproduce every original endpoint map before changed-input passes, using previously registered map tolerances; identity copy exact. If a baseline fails, stop before interpretation.
stage2_frozen_module.controls: Apply the same input variant to ordinary R1-based temporal/spatial controls. Recompute each representation using its frozen rules and coefficients; do not train a new head.
stage2_frozen_module.outcome: Report all five scores and all three representations. If the same own/foreign decisions remain, input quantization is not a sufficient correction for these cases. A change in one score or sign is a local sensitivity result, not proof of general improvement.
stage2_frozen_module.stop: No full tracker, threshold changes, parameter search, training or extra precision variants. No promotion to tracking evaluation from this draft.

scientific_text_review.method_vs_object: Input preparation and activity maps are investigated; restoration and precision comparison are methods.
scientific_text_review.duplication: Previous float16 reproduction gates do not compare removal of quantization. Previous FP32/FP64 dynamics comparisons concern other numerical operations.
scientific_text_review.actual_vs_planned: Only static source inspection and this specification are completed. Neither stage has run; no numerical or identity effect is claimed.
